description: Lists the routes for one payment side by side, with cost, speed, licence and freshness. Hard facts first (complete cost, not stale, settles by the due date, licence active, not excluded by route health). SwapEazi does not pick a route. A person chooses. Not a firm quote: confirm with the provider before approval. One analysis (POST /api/v1/payment-analyses), the same service for every payment-intelligence tool. Every figure labelled LIVE, INDICATIVE, HISTORICAL or ESTIMATED. Free: shares the route-assessment allowance.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header: names the routes and is not counted.

amount.description: Amount, in currency (default the source currency).

analysis_id.description: Read a kept analysis (pa_...) instead of making a new one.

beneficiary_amount.description: What the supplier must receive, in the destination currency (instead of amount).

currency.description: The currency of amount: the source currency, or the destination one (then it is what the supplier receives).

destination_country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 or name, e.g. ZM or Mozambique.

destination_currency.description: ISO code the supplier is paid in, e.g. ZMW. Or destination_country.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: a route that cannot settle by then is not eligible.

existing_provider.description: Your current provider: { provider, kind: quote | entered_rate | past_payment, rate (destination per source unit) or landed_amount, fees: { transaction, intermediary, payout } in the source currency, fees_deducted_destination, quoted_at, valid_until }.

invoice_text.description: Paste the invoice or a sentence (e.g. 'Invoice INV-2207, Lusaka Copper Supplies Ltd, Zambia. Amount due: EUR 80,000. Due 2026-11-20'). Or the fields below.

priority.description: Sets the default scoring weights. Default balanced.

reference.description: Optional. Your invoice or payment reference, e.g. 'INV-2207'; echoed in the analysis.

source_currency.description: ISO code you pay from, e.g. EUR or ZAR.

supplier.description: Optional. The supplier's name as on the invoice, e.g. 'Lusaka Copper Supplies Ltd'; echoed in the analysis.

weights.description: Your own scoring weights: { total_cost, speed, reliability, liquidity, compliance }, non-negative, normalised to 1.

name: recommend_payment_route
title: List routes for one payment
